title: Explicit cone steps are antitone and differential-stable
statement: Let A be a Grothendieck abelian category, K an integer-indexed cochain complex, I an (integer,natural)-indexed bicomplex, and a:K[0]→I its augmentation. Let b be an integer and assume I.X(s) and K^s are zero for s<b. Put J=((CartanEilenbergPresentation.mappedFunctor(identity)).obj I).flip [def-sp-cartan-eilenberg-presentation], and let aug:K→Tot(J) [def-sp-double-complex-total] have degree n component a(n,0) followed by the extension identification and the (0,n) diagonal inclusion. Define S(p,n) in Cone(aug)^n as the image of the K^(n+1) inclusion if p≤n+1, or zero otherwise, joined with the finite supremum of the images of J^(n-s,s)→Tot(J)^n→Cone(aug)^n for max(b,p)≤s≤n. Then p↦S(p,n) is antitone for every n, and the inclusion S(p,n)→Cone(aug)^n followed by its differential factors through S(p,n+1) for every p,n.

source.place: Lemma 12.25.4 augmentation, with Tag 012W total filtration; elementary augmented-cone variant

proof.text: Increasing p shrinks the finite interval and can only remove the K summand; finite-supremum monotonicity proves antitonicity.

Pull the next step back along the cone differential. Its K generator has components minus d_K and aug. The first factors through the next K image. By the augmentation equation the second factors through the diagonal with complex index n+1; when n+1<b its source is zero.

Each total generator of complex index s maps to signed terms with complex indices s and s+1, both in the next interval. Mathlib total_d, ι_D₁, ι_D₂, d₁_eq′ and d₂_eq′ give the calculation. Signs and sums preserve factorization.
Every generating image lies in the pullback of the next step, hence their supremum does. The pullback universal property gives the differential factorization.

theorem coneFiltrationStep_props
    {A : Type uA} [Category.{vA} A] [Abelian A] [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{vA} A]
    (K : CochainComplex A ℤ)
    (I : HomologicalComplex₂ A (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (ComplexShape.up ℕ))
    (a : ((CochainComplex.single₀ A).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K ⟶ I)
    (b : ℤ) (_hIbelow : ∀ s : ℤ, s < b → IsZero (I.X s))
    (hKbelow : ∀ s : ℤ, s < b → IsZero (K.X s))
    (aug : K ⟶ (((CartanEilenbergPresentation.mappedFunctor (𝟭 A)).obj I).flip).total
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ))
    (haug : ∀ n : ℤ, aug.f n = (a.f n).f 0 ≫
      (HomologicalComplex.extendXIso
        (((𝟭 A).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj (I.X n))
        ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat (i := 0) (i' := 0) rfl).inv ≫
      (((CartanEilenbergPresentation.mappedFunctor (𝟭 A)).obj I).flip).ιTotal
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 0 n n (zero_add n)) :
    (∀ n, Antitone (fun p ↦ coneFiltrationStep K I aug b p n)) ∧
    (∀ p n, (coneFiltrationStep K I aug b p (n + 1)).Factors
      ((coneFiltrationStep K I aug b p n).arrow ≫
        (CochainComplex.mappingCone aug).d n (n + 1)))
